newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says will discuss currencies with Clinton.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says will discuss currencies with Clinton.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Thursday he will discuss foreign exchange issues and a port dispute in talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton in Washington in late April.
"It is not only Okinawa," Hashimoto told reporters in parliament. "The port issue is continuing and we also have foreign exchange (to discuss)."
"The meeting (with Clinton) will be held at the same time as a G7 meeting (of finance ministers). Vice President (Al) Gore put weight on economic issues," Hashimoto said.

Finance ministers and central bank governors of the Group of Seven industrial nations are expected to meet ahead of International Monetary Fund (IMF) conferences due to begin on April 28. Hashimoto is to meet Clinton on April 25.
The issue of Japan's port practices, which the United States has claimed to be discriminatory, was raised when Hashimoto met Gore last month.
